rules.title: Gameplay
rules.desc: Click to earn money and upgrade your gear. Each upgrade increases your earnings per second (CPS).

rules.title: Goals & Trophies
rules.desc: Reach goals to unlock unique trophies and track your progress.

rules.title: Rebirth
rules.desc: Reset your upgrades but get a permanent bonus per click to progress faster and climb the leaderboard.

rules.title: Timer & Leaderboard
rules.desc: The leaderboard rewards active playtime: the longer you stay playing, the higher you climb.

rules.title: Mobile
rules.desc: Access your upgrades directly from your phone and keep progressing anywhere.

settings.title: Settings
settings.resetConfirm: All your progress (money, upgrades, trophies) on this device will be lost. A run you published on the leaderboard is NOT deleted: use “Withdraw my run from the leaderboard” first if you want. Confirm?
settings.withdraw: Withdraw my run from the leaderboard
settings.withdrawConfirm: Your run (name and stats) will be deleted from the public leaderboard. Confirm?
settings.withdrawDone: Your run has been removed from the leaderboard.
settings.withdrawError: Couldn't withdraw your run right now. Please try again later.
settings.withdrawUnavailable: No run can be withdrawn from this device. For a run sent from another device or before this version, use the contact given on the Privacy page.
settings.saveFailed: Your progress can't be saved on this device (storage full or disabled).

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.subtitle: Top runs, by category. Money and trophies count your cumulative progress across all rebirths.
leaderboard.name: Player
leaderboard.unverified: Unverified leaderboard: scores are reported by players' browsers.
leaderboard.publicNotice: Submitting your run publicly shows your name, stats and date. It's optional and you can withdraw it anytime from Settings.
leaderboard.empty: No runs recorded yet. Be the first!
